title: vocabularies.children
description: One page of the terms at a level, optionally only the ones a parent term scopes. This object validates the request payload; the response shape ({results, truncated}) is documented in $defs.Page. The comm half of the term listing the picker walks over HTTP — the question a caller asks when it has no code to name and no person to show a list to.

level.description: Level to list. An unknown level answers null, never an empty page.

parent.description: When given, only the terms this parent scopes are listed. A parent that names no term scopes NOTHING and answers an empty page — never the whole level.

results.description: The terms, in the level's own order (popular band first).

truncated.description: Whether the level (or the parent's children) holds more than this page. Load-bearing for a caller that reasons ABOUT the set rather than picking from it: a page cut short can make a value look unique when it is not, and page length alone cannot tell a full page from a complete one.
